requirements.requirement: Affidavit must also comply with rule 13-20.
State on the front page the style of cause and full name of the person swearing or affirming the affidavit.
State the place of residence of the person swearing or affirming the affidavit.
Be written in the first person.
Be divided into consecutively numbered paragraphs, each as nearly as may be confined to a distinct portion of the subject.
Subject to rule 13-35, be signed or acknowledged and sworn or affirmed before a person empowered to administer oaths and affirmations.
Contain a statement of when, where and before whom the affidavit was sworn or affirmed.
Be signed by the person administering the oath or taking the affirmation.

An affidavit sworn or affirmed in Saskatchewan must be sworn or affirmed before an authorized judge, registrar, notary public, justice of the peace or commissioner empowered to administer oaths or affirmations.
An affidavit is not invalid or improper solely because it was sworn or affirmed before a commencement document was filed.
No costs are to be allowed for an affidavit substantially departing from the rule.
